abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported S400.

error.invalid_address: Enter a six-byte Bluetooth MAC address.
error.invalid_key: Bindkey must be 32 hex characters and token, when supplied, 24 hex characters.

user.title: Set up Xiaomi S400
user.description: Choose the scale and enter its existing local BLE credentials.

keys.title: Use existing local credentials
keys.description: Enter the 16-byte bindkey obtained during initial provisioning. The optional 12-byte token enables automatic local GATT login and live measurements.

discovery_confirm.title: Xiaomi S400 discovered
discovery_confirm.description: Enter this scale’s existing bindkey and optional GATT token. This step does not reset or provision the scale.

reconfigure.title: Update local credentials
reconfigure.description: Replace the bindkey and token after the scale has been provisioned again. Leave token empty for passive BLE reception only.
